problem_statement: TCP sockets do not support the FIONWRITE ioctl. An application should be able to query, via zsock_ioctl() with FIONWRITE, the number of bytes queued for transmission on a connected TCP socket that have not yet been acknowledged by the peer: it should return 0 on a freshly connected socket, the count of bytes still queued after a send when the sent data cannot be delivered, and 0 again once the data has been acknowledged. For a socket in the listening state the call must fail with errno EINVAL. This mirrors the FIONREAD/FIONBIO ioctl support already present for sockets.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/tcp -s tests/net/socket/tcp/net.socket.tcp -s net.socket.tcp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
